Guided setup

We set your first agent up with you.

An hour on a call, on your own computer: the inbox, the calendar and a chat app connected, one agent running, and you able to change it after we hang up.

Which one is this?

A walkthrough · you are here

Connecting an inbox, a calendar and a chat app on one computer is an hour with us, and you leave able to run and change it yourself. We set sleep to Never with you, because your agent only works while this computer is awake.

Design and build work

More than one calendar, tools you have already wired together, or several pieces that have to keep working without you in the middle. That is Consulting: we scope it, quote the whole thing, then build it. Both are $250 an hour, so the question is not which is cheaper, but which one your setup is.

What you are setting up

Archie is the thing we set up.

Our desktop app for AI agents that run on your own computer, through your own accounts. If it can’t do something yet, tell us, and we’ll build the add-on.

What an agent handles →

Setting one up for a team instead? Archie for Business →

Pricing

One rate, told up front.

$250 a session. Each session runs an hour. The rate never goes up because your setup is complicated, but a bigger setup can take more than one session. We’ll tell you how many on the free call, before you book anything.

Archie itself is $30 a month or $299 a year when it ships, a separate cost from your sessions.

The AI itself bills you directly, never through us. While we build together that’s a standard subscription like Claude Pro, around $20 a month. After that it’s your own pay-as-you-go account. What that runs to is on the pricing page.

The free call

What you walk away with.

Whether or not you book a session afterwards. It is yours either way.

What to hand over

The parts of your week an agent could take on, named specifically, rather than “email and calendar”.

Which add-ons do it

By name, with what each one needs connected before it can work.

What it would cost to run

Worked from what you actually do, on the same figures as the pricing page. The AI bill is the part people guess wrong.

What not to automate

The parts we would leave alone, and why. There are always some.

Whether it’s the wrong tool

Said plainly, on the call, if that is the answer. Sometimes it is, and you have lost an hour instead of a year.

Cost of all 5: nothing. No follow-up sequence either: we take the call, send you the plan, and leave it with you. We are two people, so this is a handful of calls a week rather than a booking form that never fills up.
